note: What a client sends to cast something from a slot, at a point or at a unit. The header names the sender's champion.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner spell's.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot is being cast from, from 0 to 51. A client sends nothing for a slot above 51.

fields.name: x
fields.note: A point on the ground the cast is described by, along one axis, in world units.

fields.name: y
fields.note: The same point, in height, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The same point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: The second point of what aims the spell: the same as the first for a point or a unit; for a line dragged out, its far end; for a cone, its far point.

fields.name: endY
fields.note: The second point, in height, in world units.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: The second point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit aimed at, or zero where no unit is aimed at.

bits.name: slot
bits.note: Which slot is being cast from. A client sends 0, 1 or 2, for the champion's first three spells.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner spell's.

bits.name: clicked
bits.note: Set where the cast began with a click on the spell's button rather than its key.

fields.name: x
fields.note: A point on the ground the cast is described by, along one axis, in world units.

fields.name: z
fields.note: The same point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: endX
fields.note: The second point of what aims the spell: the same as x and z for a point or a unit; for a line dragged out, its far end, cut to the spell's length; for a cone, its far point.

fields.name: endZ
fields.note: The second point, along the other axis, in world units.

fields.name: target
fields.note: The unit aimed at; for a spell that takes no aim, the caster itself, with its own position in both points. Zero only where no unit is aimed at.
